summary: Engineering plan written: every spec decision mapped to a file, 12 risks each with a detection path, 13 pre-flight gates, ADR-0021 referenced. No blocking open question.

Lineup column shipped end to end. Every gate passes at 100 percent coverage. Two plan deviations: the migration is nullable because Aurora DSQL rejects every constraint on ADD COLUMN, and on a phone the column sits on the artist line because inline it collapsed the title to one character. One ratified metric remains unmet and needs a product call: a twenty character title truncates at 360 px, and did so before this branch added a column.

The implementation worktree branch merged into the designated branch with no conflict on any of its 54 paths. The blueprint index was stale after the merge and was regenerated. eslint over apps/pragma and tsc --noEmit in apps/pragma both pass on the merge commit.

head: 3e47bb1de7b3947fe99d0f5e084248615c5313d3
summary: Every gate passes: eslint, prettier, typecheck, knip, vocabulary, convention-drift, blueprint indexing, doc links, and the full pragma suite at 199 files and 1988 tests with 100 percent per file on all four axes. No dependency was added anywhere in the repository and the bass glyph's two fretboard edges are exactly parallel at slope -1. Every implementation-bearing spec decision landed and the three highest plan risks each have a named back-e2e case. Two non-behavioural blockers: a dead maximumVisibleLineupMembers export that knip and the coverage gate both miss because its own test is its only consumer, and a FollowsBlueprint marker on InstrumentsList naming organism-query-owning when the file calls no query hook. The unmet 360 px title metric is a visual-validation row and a product call, not scored here.

Both validation blockers closed and nothing else touched. The dead maximumVisibleLineupMembers export, its two constants, its only caller in its own sibling test and MemberLineup's never-passed maximumVisible prop are gone. The InstrumentsList marker now names organism-presentational, which is what the component is: it calls no query hook and takes every value as a prop from InstrumentsPage. Eslint, prettier, tsc, knip, the core suite at 1824 tests and the per-file coverage gate all pass.

The fix round merged into the designated branch. One conflict, in this journal: the validation FAIL line on the branch and the implementation-02 line on the worktree side were both appended at the end, and both are kept in the order the events happened. The three code paths merged clean. The validation artifacts left uncommitted in the working tree were committed first, as 434a271a, so the branch carries the verdict that asked for this round. eslint over apps/pragma, tsc --noEmit in apps/pragma, blueprint-indexing --check and convention-drift --check all pass on the merged tree.

head: 59c88907fe5e29f9d6d2dc1189678158ea66433c
summary: Both round-one blockers are closed: the dead maximumVisibleLineupMembers export with its constants and MemberLineup's never-passed prop are gone, and the InstrumentsList marker now names organism-presentational, which the component actually is. Every gate is green on the merged tree: eslint over all fifty changed files and over the whole pragma workspace, prettier, typecheck, knip, blueprint indexing, convention drift, vocabulary paths, the style comment sweep, doc links, and the full suite at 199 files and 1985 tests with 100 percent per file on all four axes, migration audit included. No dependency was added anywhere, the bass glyph's two fretboard edges are both at slope -1 with a cross product of 7.1e-15, and all six new gated files carry a sibling test. All nine implementation-bearing spec decisions and all sixteen Changes entries landed, and every spec assertion in scope has a test. This round additionally proved the migration's position and is_primary backfills by hand against seeded rows, which the truncating e2e harness cannot reach. Repo-root eslint OOMs in this container and was replaced by two scoped runs through node with a raised heap; logged to KAIZEN.md. Visual validation has not run and the 360 px twenty-character title metric is still open on that side.

blockers: The lineup column renders zero slots on freshly migrated and seeded data: the migration seeds instrument.position but nothing seeds member_instrument.is_primary, and slots are drawn from primary instruments only, so every card shows a 4 px empty column and the member avatars it replaced are gone.

At 375x667 only five songs are fully visible, not the six the spec asserts: the list band between the sticky energy chart (ends y=71) and the floating action bar (starts y=550) is 479 px and six cards with their seams need 528 px. Six are visible at 375x812 and at 360x780.

At 360 px a twenty-character title truncates: the title box is 104 px and the text needs 131 px, while the lineup column has already stopped yielding at four slots plus +1 and holds 96 px. The spec says the column yields before the title and the title never truncates to feed the column.

A rejected energy write is silent: with the entry PUT aborted, the row kept the optimistic value, no failure line appeared anywhere, and the server still held the previous value until a reload. The spec asks for the row to return to its previous value and surface the existing failure line.
summary: Forty assertions driven in a real browser against the running app. The feature itself works once the data supports it: the lineup column holds one fixed slot per instrument at identical x on every row, tints each slot with its holder's colour, yields from the right with a +N marker whose title names the hidden instruments, caps at members plus two, falls back to the generic glyph for an instrument with no icon, and opens the lineup editor on a real tap. The three card tones behave, including grey winning over yellow when an override empties the lineup, and the old override badge is gone. The card is 54 px, the held seam 24 px and the risky seam 36 px, exactly as the Result table claims. The energy meter is 78x44 px, moves one level per 32 px, keeps the pointer past its own bounds, carries touch-action none, commits on release and survives a reload, under both a real pointer and argent's drag. Four things fail: the column is empty on day one because nothing seeds is_primary, the six-songs-at-375 metric holds at 780 and 812 height but gives five at 667, a twenty-character title truncates at 360 px while the column keeps width it does not need, and a rejected energy write leaves the optimistic value on screen with no failure line. Broken-image scan empty on all fourteen screenshots.
